admin-basics.title: Getting around the admin console
admin-basics.summary: The left menu, quick search, notifications, language and the button that reopens this guide.

admin-dashboard.title: Dashboard
admin-dashboard.summary: Today's key figures, revenue and order trends, and locker capacity.

admin-orders.title: Orders
admin-orders.summary: Filter, search and open any parcel, box rental or drone delivery order.

customer-home.title: Lock.R home
customer-home.summary: Send parcels, rent boxes, book drones, scan at the locker and follow active orders.

locker-tech-home.title: Locker technician home
locker-tech-home.summary: Go on shift, see pending work and the tabs for locker checks, incidents and routine maintenance.

drone-tech-home.title: Drone technician home
drone-tech-home.summary: Go on shift to receive orders, see pending work and the dispatch, fleet and incident tabs.

admin-users.title: Accounts
admin-users.summary: See user figures, filter and search accounts, and create accounts for staff.

admin-lockers.title: Kiosks (lockers)
admin-lockers.summary: Track every locker: status, store and assigned technician; put a locker into maintenance or bring it back.

admin-drones.title: Drone fleet
admin-drones.summary: See how many drones are idle, charging or faulty at a glance; add drones and open each one.

admin-storage.title: Items in storage
admin-storage.summary: Orders not picked up in time are moved to storage; customers collect them at the counter after paying the overdue fee.

admin-refunds.title: Refunds
admin-refunds.summary: Approve or reject refund requests, look up the history and the reconciliation rules.

customer-orders.title: Your orders
customer-orders.summary: See orders you sent and orders sent to you, filter by status, and open one for its pickup code.

customer-profile.title: Account
customer-profile.summary: Personal details, refund account, security, and the guide.

locker-tech-inspect.title: Locker check
locker-tech-inspect.summary: Pick a locker, check each cell and report a fault found on site.

drone-tech-dispatch.title: Drone dispatch
drone-tech-dispatch.summary: Check the weather at drone lockers and turn on pickup jobs while on shift.

admin-basics-intro.title: Welcome to the Lock.R admin console
admin-basics-intro.body: Here you track orders, lockers, drones, technicians and revenue. This guide walks through the parts you use most and takes about a minute.

admin-basics-sidebar.title: Main menu
admin-basics-sidebar.body: Every admin page lives here, grouped by area: Lockers & operations, Drones, Finance, Users… Use the arrow at the top of the menu to collapse it.

admin-basics-search.title: Quick search
admin-basics-search.body: Type a page name, order code or locker code to jump straight to it. Shortcut: Ctrl + K.

admin-basics-notifications.title: Notifications
admin-basics-notifications.body: Refund requests, new tickets, drone incidents and more appear under this bell. The red number counts unread items.

admin-basics-language.title: Language
admin-basics-language.body: Switch between Vietnamese and English. Your choice is remembered.

admin-basics-guide.title: Reopen the guide
admin-basics-guide.body: Use this button at any time to replay the guide, pick the sections you want, or turn automatic guides on or off.

admin-dashboard-kpis.title: Key figures
admin-dashboard-kpis.body: Revenue, orders, customers and active lockers. Click a card to see the detailed list.

admin-dashboard-trend.title: Trends over time
admin-dashboard-trend.body: Revenue and orders per day. Pick the year on the chart card.

admin-dashboard-capacity.title: Infrastructure capacity
admin-dashboard-capacity.body: How many boxes are free, holding parcels or reporting faults across the system.

admin-dashboard-locations.title: Busiest locker sites
admin-dashboard-locations.body: Lockers ranked by orders and revenue, so you know where to add boxes or technicians.

admin-orders-filters.title: Order filters
admin-orders-filters.body: Filter by order type, status, payment and date range. Clear filters resets the list.

admin-orders-list.title: Order list
admin-orders-list.body: Each row is one order. Click a row to open its details: timeline, payment, pickup code and drone journey.

admin-orders-detail.title: Order details
admin-orders-detail.body: On the detail page, the "Pickup code" card shows the PIN and QR code the customer uses at the locker, who holds the code and whether it still works.

customer-home-intro.title: Welcome to Lock.R
customer-home-intro.body: Lock.R lets you send parcels through lockers, rent a box for your things and deliver by drone. Here are the main buttons.

customer-home-quick.title: Shortcuts
customer-home-quick.body: Find a nearby locker, send a parcel, rent a box or open more services in one tap.

customer-home-scan.title: Scan at the locker
customer-home-scan.body: In front of a locker, tap here to scan the QR code on the kiosk screen and open your box.

customer-home-notifications.title: Notifications
customer-home-notifications.body: Pickup codes, pickup reminders and drone progress all arrive here. A red dot means unread messages.

customer-home-active.title: Active order
customer-home-active.body: Your latest order holding a box or on its way shows here with each milestone. Tap it for details.

customer-home-tabs.title: Navigation bar
customer-home-tabs.body: Switch between Home, lockers, your orders and your account.

customer-home-guide.title: Reopen the guide
customer-home-guide.body: Tap this button at any time to replay the guide or turn automatic guides on or off.

locker-tech-home-intro.title: Welcome, locker technician
locker-tech-home-intro.body: Here you receive incident tickets, run routine locker checks and manage the IoT devices of your lockers.

locker-tech-home-shift.title: Go on shift
locker-tech-home-shift.body: Turn on "On shift" when you start work to receive new tickets. The app needs location access to know which locker you are near.

locker-tech-home-hud.title: Pending work
locker-tech-home-hud.body: Incidents waiting, work in progress, routine schedules and the stations you cover. Tap a tile to jump to its tab.

locker-tech-home-tabs.title: Work tabs
locker-tech-home-tabs.body: Inspect, Incidents, My work, Routine, IoT devices and Drone parcel recovery. Swipe sideways to see them all.

locker-tech-home-guide.title: Reopen the guide
locker-tech-home-guide.body: Tap this button at any time to replay the guide or turn automatic guides on or off.

drone-tech-home-intro.title: Welcome, drone technician
drone-tech-home-intro.body: Here you take drone delivery orders, collect parcels from customers, load drones, follow flights and maintain the fleet.

drone-tech-home-shift.title: Go on shift
drone-tech-home-shift.body: Turn on "On shift" so the system can offer you the nearest pickup. Location must be on to measure distance.

drone-tech-home-hud.title: Pending work
drone-tech-home-hud.body: Orders waiting for dispatch, flights in the air and maintenance jobs. Tap a tile to jump to its tab.

drone-tech-home-tabs.title: Work tabs
drone-tech-home-tabs.body: Dispatch, Fleet, Incidents, My work, Routine and Flight tools. Swipe sideways to see them all.

drone-tech-home-guide.title: Reopen the guide
drone-tech-home-guide.body: Tap this button at any time to replay the guide or turn automatic guides on or off.

admin-users-stats.title: User figures
admin-users-stats.body: Total accounts, active ones, new this month… Click a card to filter the list to that group.

admin-users-filters.title: Filter and create accounts
admin-users-filters.body: Search by name, email, phone or role and filter by status. "Add user" creates an account for a staff member.

admin-users-list.title: Account list
admin-users-list.body: Click a row to open the profile: roles, wallet, reward points, orders and payments.

admin-lockers-filters.title: Filter lockers
admin-lockers-filters.body: Filter by status, store and assigned technician, including lockers nobody is assigned to.

admin-lockers-list.title: Locker list
admin-lockers-list.body: Each row is a locker with its free cells. Click it for the cell map; the row menu puts it into maintenance or reactivates it.

admin-drones-summary.title: Fleet status
admin-drones-summary.body: Cards count idle, charging and faulty drones. Click a card or a status chip to see only that group.

admin-drones-add.title: Add a drone
admin-drones-add.body: Register a new drone: its code, home locker and assigned technician.

admin-drones-list.title: Each drone
admin-drones-list.body: Each card shows battery, locker, technician and any fault. Click it for flight and maintenance logs.

admin-storage-stats.title: Storage overview
admin-storage-stats.body: Items in storage, those still owing the overdue fee and those fully paid. Click a card to filter.

admin-storage-list.title: Items in storage
admin-storage-list.body: Search by order code or phone. When the customer arrives: open the item, check the phone number, collect what is owed, then hand it over to close the order.

admin-refunds-stats.title: Refund requests
admin-refunds-stats.body: Counts of pending, refunded and rejected requests. Click a card to filter by status.

admin-refunds-tabs.title: Three work areas
admin-refunds-tabs.body: "Pending" to review, "History" to look up, "Rules" to check before sending a refund transfer.

admin-refunds-pending.title: Review a request
admin-refunds-pending.body: Each request shows the amount, order and receiving account. Approve once the transfer is done (with its reference), or reject with a reason.

customer-orders-scope.title: Sent / Received
customer-orders-scope.body: Switch between orders you created and orders sent to you. Received orders carry a cell code once the parcel is in the locker.

customer-orders-filters.title: Filter orders
customer-orders-filters.body: Filter by status (recent, in use, completed) and by service type.

customer-orders-list.title: Order list
customer-orders-list.body: Tap an order for details: pickup PIN / QR, payment, drone journey and receiver delegation.

customer-profile-header.title: Your profile
customer-profile-header.body: Avatar, name and membership tier. Tap to edit your details.

customer-profile-refund.title: Refund account
customer-profile-refund.body: Add your bank and account number to receive money when an order is refunded.

customer-profile-guide.title: User guide
customer-profile-guide.body: Replay the on-screen guide any time, open the manual, and turn automatic guides on or off.

locker-tech-inspect-picker.title: Pick a locker
locker-tech-inspect-picker.body: Choose the locker to check from the ones you are assigned to.

locker-tech-inspect-locker.title: Locker status
locker-tech-inspect-locker.body: Whether the controller is online, reserved and occupied cells, cells by size. "Directions" takes you there.

locker-tech-inspect-report.title: Report a locker fault
locker-tech-inspect-report.body: Only after confirming a physical fault on site: title, description, photo and an option to pause new orders.

drone-tech-dispatch-weather.title: Weather at drone lockers
drone-tech-dispatch-weather.body: Shows which lockers can fly in the next 30 minutes; rain or strong wind is flagged.

drone-tech-dispatch-duty.title: Pickup jobs
drone-tech-dispatch-duty.body: Turn on while on shift to be offered drone delivery jobs; while busy with one you will not get more offers.
